alt.en: The week view for 5 to 11 December 2026, one block per park day on an hour axis, with "Universal day 1 of 3" to "Universal day 3 of 3", "Disney day 1 of 4" and "Disney day 2 of 4" above the columns.

caption.en: Saturday stays free as the arrival day, which is the default. If you land early, "Park on arrival day" under "More options" adds a park to it.
